conflict: For a<b use min(b mod a, a-(b mod a))<2; equality 2 is compatible.
family: Independent sets of the new conflict graph, with inherited 87/88 edge.
weights: D is product of candidate numerators, weight_i=2D/a_i. Exact reciprocal sum of added candidates only.
construction: Memoized include/exclude DAG; counts, maximum scaled weight and tie count for every cardinality.
reader: Saved DAG seeded into reader; new conditional states are permitted and counted. Fixed-label bitvector lexicographic rank, 0 before 1.
limitations: Finite selected candidate set, not all rational extensions.
No inference about convergence or infinite well-separated sets.
No old prefix-membership or CRT rebuild.
